title: MMA-ASIA: A MULTILINGUAL AND MULTI-MODAL ALIGNMENT FRAMEWORK FOR CULTURALLY-GROUNDED EVALUATION
reasoning: The paper presents a benchmark for cultural awareness in Asian contexts that includes components evaluating knowledge of spiritual and religious traditions. Specifically, it contains knowledge points and test items regarding religious architecture (e.g., Buddhist grottoes), religious art (e.g., Buddhist murals), and spiritual/mythological figures (e.g., Taoist mythology and figures from the 'Journey to the West').
